rationale: Although MELI bounced off the $1500.00 level and reclaimed the 5-minute 9-EMA ($1504.25), the subsequent spike to $1511.94 occurred on lighter volume (4,110 shares) and immediately rejected Session VWAP ($1510.21) back down to $1507.87.
